hadith_en: It was narrated from Abu Najih As-Sulami (may Allah be pleased with him) that he said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) say: ‘Whoever sends forth an arrow in the cause of Allah will have a degree (of reward)...’ and he continued with the rest of the Hadith. And I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) say: "Any Muslim man who frees a Muslim man, Allah will place in protection from the Hellfire one of his bones in place of each bone of the man he freed. And any Muslim woman who frees a Muslim woman, Allah will likewise place in protection from the Hellfire one of her bones in place of each bone of the woman she freed on the Day of Resurrection.”.
syarah_en: Firing an arrow in the cause of Allah and freeing slaves are both acts of great virtue in the sight of Allah.This Hadith clearly outlines their immense reward. The prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said: “Whoever sends forth an arrow in the cause of Allah will have a degree (of reward),” meaning that if an arrow reaches the enemy and causes injury or harm in them, the one who shot it earns a rank and a noble status in Paradise. He then continued: “And any Muslim man who frees a Muslim man, Allah will place in protection from the Hellfire one of his bones in place of each bone of the man he freed.” That is, every bone of the emancipator will be spared from the Hellfire in exchange for every bone of the freed person, serving as ransom from punishment. This reward is specified for freeing a Muslim, as it brings greater benefit and spiritual merit, unlike the freeing of a non-believer. The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) also clarified that women shall receive the same reward: “And any Muslim woman who frees a Muslim woman, Allah will place in protection from the Hellfire one of her bones in place of each bone of the woman she freed on the Day of Resurrection.” It has been said that freeing a male slave carries greater merit, is more complete, and brings a greater reward. This is due to the broader benefits that may result from a man’s strength, capabilities, and the responsibilities he can fulfill.It has also been reported that freeing two women equates to the reward of freeing one man.The Hadith highlights the virtue of the one who frees a believing soul..
